Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling northbound on the main roadway in Sugar Land, Texas, when the vehicle entered a controlled
intersection and was struck on the driver side by Driver 2, whose vehicle was southbound and proceeding through on
a green signal. The impact pattern on both vehicles is consistent with a broadside collision at moderate speed.
Damage to the driver side of Driver 1's vehicle is largely consistent with the described impact, and photographs taken
at the scene confirm several of the reported points of contact. No independent witnesses were located, and no prior
damage to Driver 1's vehicle is known to responding officers. Driver 1 was seen seated behind the wheel on arrival,
and a Passenger was also present in the vehicle, a fact confirmed by both the responding officers and statements
from the drivers. Driver 1 reported neck pain and stiffness at the scene, which is consistent with the force and
direction of the collision. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy associated with the vehicle. Medical
assistance was requested and the scene was cleared at the end of the investigation.
